services.name: code-index-embed
services.description: Embeds the code-index chunks that are not embedded yet.

services.name: code-index-main-move
services.description: Starts a code-index update for each repo whose main branch moved.

services.name: context-concept-scan
services.description: Scans each new context map version for the concepts the code names, for the glossary.

services.name: context-map-refresh
services.description: Builds the context map again so it stays current.

services.name: context-sync-gaps
services.description: Starts a sync for a context source that has never synced.

services.name: pr-watch
services.description: Watches the pull requests that wait on the forge.

services.name: router-stub
services.description: Routes each started item to its workflow.

services.name: setup
services.description: Keeps the setup checklist in step with the profile.

services.name: workflow-events
services.description: Passes ledger events to the running workflows.
